scope: First-crest live forecast, display starting at t=.2, integrated catalog wrapping; not physical wave acceptance.

checks.expiry: Predicted threshold passed does not assert measured arrival or enable cycle acceptance.
checks.case_isolation: Wrong case/unavailable clear target, remaining, wall, current and note.
checks.plot_display: All displayed series begin at .20000000000000015 s; initial spike excluded from axis scaling. Mobile Follow live reaches latest right edge.
checks.raw_history: All40 startup rows remain from.0005s; main CSV retains180 pre-.2s samples. No history was rewritten.
checks.layout: No JS errors, page overflow, nonfinite plot paths or catalog cell text-bound violations in six combinations.
checks.visual: Desktop/mobile countdown and catalog screenshots reviewed. Main print pages5/7 and professor2/4 reviewed; no text collision or cut table rows.
checks.actions: Read-only browser GET/HEAD only; no CFD, HTTP-service restart, solver or lock action.
